BillHeading.BriefDescription: Designating the Pacific geoduck as the state clam.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating the Pacific geoduck as the state clam; and adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The Panopea generosa, more commonly known as the Pacific geoduck, is hereby designated as the official clam of the state of Washington.
